On our Mali-G610 (Panthor driver) system, UI compositing (high priority) stutters during heavy background compute (low priority). Perfetto shows the compositing GPU queue waiting behind compute queue workloads.

Perfetto trace (GPU track):
  t=0ms:    compute_queue (prio=MEDIUM): job_A dispatch
  t=4ms:    composite_queue (prio=HIGH): blocked waiting for CSF slot
  t=12ms:   compute_queue job_A complete
  t=12.1ms: composite_queue: frame delivered (12ms stall!)

drm_sched entity priorities:
  composite_entity: priority=DRM_SCHED_PRIORITY_HIGH
  compute_entity: priority=DRM_SCHED_PRIORITY_NORMAL

But both entities are in the same CSF queue group (group_0). What is the panthor-queue-priority-inversion failure mode and how do CSF queue groups need to be configured to prevent it?
